指定生命周期规则是否允许前缀重叠。取值如下：

description.en:
Specifies whether lifecycle rules allow prefix overlap. Valid values:

true: Prefix overlap is allowed.

false: Prefix overlap is not allowed.

title.zh: 设置存储空间的生命周期规则
title.en: Configure lifecycle rules for a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket的拥有者以及被授予PutBucketLifecycle权限的RAM用户才能发起配置生命周期规则的请求。

- 如果Bucket此前没有设置过生命周期规则，此操作会创建一个新的生命周期规则；如果Bucket此前设置过生命周期规则，此操作会覆写先前的规则配置。

- PutBucketLifecycle是覆盖语义。当您需要追加生命周期规则时，请先调用GetBucketLifecycle接口获取当前生命周期规则配置，然后追加新的生命周期规则配置，最后调用PutBucketLifecycle接口更新生命周期规则配置。

- PutBucketLifecycle操作可以对Object以及Part（以分片方式上传，但最后未提交的分片）设置过期时间。
descriptions.en:
- Only the bucket owner and Resource Access Management (RAM) users who have been granted the PutBucketLifecycle permission can initiate a request to configure lifecycle rules.

- If no lifecycle rules have been set for the bucket, this operation creates a new lifecycle rule. If lifecycle rules have been set for the bucket, this operation overwrites the existing rule configurations.

- PutBucketLifecycle uses overwrite semantics. To append lifecycle rules, invoke the GetBucketLifecycle operation to obtain the current lifecycle rule configurations, append the new lifecycle rule configurations, and then invoke the PutBucketLifecycle operation to update the lifecycle rule configurations.

- The PutBucketLifecycle operation can set the expire time for objects and parts (parts that are uploaded by using multipart upload but are not committed).
